baristas.line: I know some Vaccinista tote bag chic baristas
stanza: I know some Vaccinista tote bag chic baristas
Sitting in east on their communista keisters
"I like my men like I like my coffee
Full of soy milk and so sweet, it won't offend anybody"
While staining the pages of The Nation, oh, yeah

sandinistas.line: My family left Honduras when they killed the Sandinistas
stanza: And a mother from my youth
For my children, I did what I had to do
My family left Honduras when they killed the Sandinistas
We followed a coyote through the dust of Mexico
Every one of them except for me survived
